fact: The Malawi Police Service introduced an electronic payment system for traffic fines, scheduled to become operational at Police Headquarters and the six police regions from the week of 4 September 2026, payable through commercial banks.
system: Malawi Police Service electronic traffic fine payment

fact: UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme says the ASYCUDAWorld 4.3.3 upgrade aims at implementing e-payment for collection of Malawi Bureau of Standards fees.
The E-Government Director said the ministry piloted migration of non-tax revenue collection agencies to e-payment, starting with the National Registration Bureau.
